label: sec:hecke-chi-closed-forms-chi-per-irrep-preamble
html: Building on the symmetric character \chi_{(3)} of the preceding section, one derives the cyclotomic rational closed forms for the remaining irreducible representations of H_3(q) on the proton and neutron braids: the sign-substituted alternating character \chi_{(1,1,1)}, the two-dimensional Hoefsmit matrix trace \chi_{(2,1)}, and the per-block Hopf–Jones absorption pattern of their leading-order coefficients.
